name: AI Agent tool: look up company contact details

parameters.content:
# Give an AI Agent the ability to look up contacts

An AI Agent with a tool to find emails, phone numbers, and social media links for any business domain. Ask it: *"Find contact info for acme.com"*.

## Setup (once)

**1. Get an Apify token** — https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations

**2. Create the n8n credential**
Credentials → New → **Header Auth**
- Name: `Apify API`
- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`

Every HTTP node here points at that credential by name. No token is stored in this file.

## Cost

Pay-per-event: $0.006 per domain where a contact (email or phone) is found (down to $0.003 on Gold tier, from $3.00 per 1,000). Blocked, unreachable, and zero-contact domains are completely free.

Current pricing: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/website-contact-finder/pricing

Actor: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/website-contact-finder
Templates & docs: https://github.com/sumitrmardy/website-contact-finder-api

options.systemMessage: You are a sales intelligence assistant. When asked for contact details about a company, use the Find Contacts Tool. Summarize all discovered emails, phone numbers (with E.164 formatted numbers), and social profiles clearly. If no contacts are found, explain that the domain is either unreachable or publishes no public contact info.

parameters.toolDescription: Searches a website or business domain for contact information (emails, phones, social links, addresses). Provide an array of domains in `domains`.

values.name: domains
values.description: A JSON array of domains to crawl for contacts, e.g. ["stripe.com"].
